title: A palm and two clipped evergreens on Pullman's palm-house terrace
items: A palm from the palm house now stands out in its tub on the terrace before the glass drum, as J. W. Taylor's photograph shows it in summer.

A slim clipped evergreen column stands against the drum's west side, and a clipped cone in its tub before the arched door east of it, where both the 1894 Inland Architect plate and Taylor's photograph place them.
The ivy on Pullman's west front is planted again against the house as it now stands, with its porch brought forward.
Like the other tub plants, they are wintered under glass: switch the Season to winter and they are gone.
